findings.title: Absolute session timeout semantics are unresolved
facts: Version 0 requires an absolute timeout below 60 minutes. Version 1 proposes resetting auth_time during token renewal.
inferences: The proposed renewal rule could move the absolute session boundary. This review does not establish deployed behavior.
questions: Which approved rule requires fresh authentication, and which actions may reset auth_time?
